Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 – Pre-order Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 releases October 23, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order today: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-standard-edition-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1082-01&utm_id=P1082-01

Want to try the game before you pre-order? The Modern Warfare 4 Open Beta is August 28, 2026 at 10am PT to September 1, 2026 at 10am PT! Pre-load the beta on your Nintendo Switch 2: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/call-of-duty-modern-warfare-4-beta-70070000038499-switch-2/?utm_source=SW&utm_medium=soytnoa&utm_campaign=P1082-01&utm_id=P1082-01

Dive right into the action with Multiplayer modes, a playable Campaign mission, Ground War, and much more. Earn exclusive Beta rewards that carry over when the game officially launches!

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight – Mayhem Collection DLC Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
The Mayhem Collection DLC, included in LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight Deluxe Edition, releases September 18, 2026 on Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order today: https://ninten.do/6007aPnmb 

Who's ready to become Gotham City's Most Wanted? 

LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight is a brand-new, open world action-adventure that invites players to embark on Bruce Wayne’s epic journey to become the hero of Gotham City. It's inspired by decades of Batman films, television, comic books, and games, and jam-packed with Batman nostalgia, DC lore, and TT Games’ signature brand of fun-filled LEGO humor.
